title: Puharich's prosthetic finger with an ELF chip

tellings.quote: he says in his own words, he invented this prosthetic finger that would have a a chip with a certain ELF frequency that

plain: In the 1970s, Andrija Puharich, a researcher of the mind and the paranormal, invented a prosthetic finger with a chip inside that gave off a particular ELF signal (extremely low frequency radio waves). An unnamed guest tells Michels this and says Puharich describes the invention 'in his own words', but does not name where. The guest raises it as an example of Puharich's experiments with low-frequency waves and the body.
